rows.agency_label: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
rows.claim: Published request and agency response; not an appropriation or solicitation.
rows.explanation: Hire Additional Health Department Inspectors for Bar, Restaurant, Nightlife, Cart and Rodent Inspection. Additional inspectors are necessary due to the number of businesses open & opening in our district. With the unprecedented growth in our community, services are at an all-time high demand. Response times for inspectors for follow up visits need to be increased. The manpower must be available to do site visits and follow -up services in our boundaries. Additionally with new development rat dens are disturbed and the impact is being felt by the community with rats transversing our streets even making dens in our tree pits. Manpower is essential for the cleanliness of our district.
rows.headline: Increase health and safety inspections, e.g. for restaurants and childcare programs
rows.response: OMB supports the agency's position as follows: This request has already been completed. Explanation: Public Health Sanitarians and Exterminators are niche public service positions that require minimum education and certifications. Challenges remain for recruitment and hiring as these civil service title requirements are governed by state laws and remains a challenge
